name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Blue Razz Jolli Popz + Sour Apple Jolli Popz
description:
Sweet meets sour in this bold pairing. Sour Apple Jollipopz delivers a crisp, tangy bite, while Blue Razz Jollipopz adds a sweet, candy-like finish. Switch between flavors or blend them for a perfectly balanced hit.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
